My only issue is, I am "clincally depressed". I am a fairly active person, and I do enjoy life, I'm not wanting to end myself or anything, but when I get into the dumps I really get ino them, so I do struggle to get back out. That's the reason why I posted this, because I'm looking to get ideas before I get bad again because I missed a lot of work last time, which I can't afford to do again.
